name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and accurately describes the function: it plays the variant-B spell pre-cast 'slide' circle-band animation. 'variant_b' is a meaningful family tag (heal-style spells routed via fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast, distinct from the offensive-A family). No address residue in the name.
purpose: Plays the 16-frame radial circle-band 'slide' pre-cast animation centered on the cursor tile, shared by the 4 variant-B (heal-style) spell dispatch thunks (spell ids 0xD/0xE/0xF/0x10) before fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast applies the healing.
logic_summary: Computes cursor pixel center (cursor_screen_x*0x18+0xC, cursor_screen_y*0x18+0x10). malloc(0x25680) snapshot buffer and composites the current battle tile map into it at +0x8088 (stride 0x1C8, tile 0xD x 8 at the battle view-window origin). Phase 1 slide-DOWN (frame_iter 9..1, 9 frames): each frame restores the tile backdrop via memmove(large_game_state_buffer, snapshot, 0x25680), draws the filled circle band at the cursor pixel pos with the current radius (offset0, grown by step each frame), blits the composed buffer to mode-13h framebuffer 0xA0504, then offset0+=step and a 5-tick delay. 200ms pause. Phase 2 slide-UP (frame_iter 3..9, 7 frames): identical per-frame work but the radius is HELD CONSTANT at (offset0 - step) for all 7 frames -- the asm subtracts step from the radius accumulator (ESI) exactly once at 0x21FA0 and never modifies it inside the loop, so after Phase 1 advanced offset0 by 9*step the value (offset0 - step) = initial + 8*step is reused unchanged; the loop variable iterates forward through the same tile-anim table to step the sprite frame. Each sprite frame is *(int*)(tile_anim_table_base + 6 + frame_iter*4) added back to the table base. Cleanup: free(snapshot), fd2_composite_battle_frame(0), 200ms pause; the normal path tail-jumps into the shared inline epilogue fragment fd2_noop_stub_b43 (no explicit RET in the binary).

params.semantics: Initial circle-band radius (offset0). Starting radius handed to fd2_render_filled_circle_band_anim; grown by step each Phase-1 frame, then reused (minus step) as the fixed Phase-2 radius. Per-spell value supplied by caller: 0xD=1, 0xE=2, 0xF=8, 0x10=6.

params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_2; does not convey meaning. It is the per-frame radius step; src/ already names it step. Rename deferred to Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value. Normal path tail-calls (JMP) the shared inline epilogue fragment fd2_noop_stub_b43 instead of emitting its own RET.
